classification.difficultyReason: Count faces, edges and vertices of five supplied solids, including hidden features.

content.prompt: Find the number of faces, edges and vertices of the following solids.

spec.description: Slanted quadrilateral prism with eight vertices, three dashed hidden edges and the source right-angle marker at the lower-left corner. Ordinary source blue and red strokes are rendered black; dashing preserves hidden-edge meaning.
spec.mathematics: Two quadrilateral ends and four lateral faces; eight vertices and twelve edges.
spec.answerVisibility: Unlabelled supplied solid only; counts appear in answers.

answer.worked: Faces: 2 quadrilateral ends and 4 side faces give 6. Edges: 4 on each end and 4 joining them give 12. Vertices: 4 on each end give 8.

spec.description: Upright triangular prism with visible upper triangular end, dashed lower rear edges and dashed rear vertical edge; retains the small right-angle mark at the lower rear vertex. Ordinary strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: Two triangular ends and three quadrilateral side faces; six vertices and nine edges.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied solid only; no counts printed.

answer.worked: Faces: 2 triangular ends and 3 side faces give 5. Edges: 3 on each end and 3 joining them give 9. Vertices: 3 on each end give 6.

spec.description: Triangular pyramid with three base vertices, one apex and a dashed rear base edge. Ordinary strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: One triangular base and three triangular side faces; four vertices and six edges.

answer.worked: Faces: 1 triangular base and 3 triangular sides give 4. Edges: 3 base edges and 3 edges to the apex give 6. Vertices: 3 base vertices and the apex give 4.

spec.description: Hexagonal pyramid with four visible base vertices and two rear base vertices; rear base edges and the two rear apex edges are dashed. Ordinary strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: One hexagonal base and six triangular faces; six base vertices plus apex; six base edges plus six lateral edges.
spec.answerVisibility: No counts or identifying name printed on the supplied figure.

answer.worked: Faces: 1 hexagonal base and 6 triangular sides give 7. Edges: 6 base edges and 6 edges to the apex give 12. Vertices: 6 base vertices and the apex give 7.

spec.description: Quadrilateral pyramid with three visible base vertices and one rear vertex; the three hidden edges meeting at the rear vertex are dashed. Ordinary strokes are black.
spec.mathematics: One quadrilateral base and four triangular side faces; five vertices and eight edges.
spec.answerVisibility: Supplied figure only; counts appear in answers.

answer.worked: Faces: 1 quadrilateral base and 4 triangular sides give 5. Edges: 4 base edges and 4 edges to the apex give 8. Vertices: 4 base vertices and the apex give 5.
